For philanthropists & foundations

Join the GoSports movement

Real change comes from strong systems. Your contribution helps build environments where athletes can train better, compete stronger, and achieve more — and every gift is tracked, accountable, and outcome-driven.

Build stronger systems

Your support helps create structured, high-performance environments for athletes — from coaching to sports science.

Back athletes that matter

Support high-potential athletes at critical stages of their journey, when access to the right resources matters most.

Create measurable impact

Every contribution is tracked and reported against outcomes — a model built on transparency, not just intent.

Choose your impact

What your gift makes possible

₹10,000A month of nutrition and recovery support for one athlete in a supported academy.
Popular₹25,000A full sports-science assessment for an athlete — the entry point to our high-performance pathway.
₹50,000A season of structured coaching support for one athlete under the Academy Development Model.
₹1,00,000A year of mentorship and competition exposure for one high-potential athlete.
₹2,50,000Technology and performance-tracking tools for an entire academy training group.
₹5,00,000A named contribution toward one of our Academy Development Model pillars for a full year.

Or fund the system behind the system: unrestricted gifts sustain the research, technology, and staff capacity that every programme runs on — see Sustaining the System.

Beta note: the amounts above match the live donation page; the "what this funds" line for each is illustrative, written to give a gift meaning rather than just a number. Confirm real per-tier costs with programme leads before this goes live.
